item.title: Far-right Israeli minister condemned for taunting handcuffed Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: France and Italy are among the countries that have criticised a video showing Itamar Ben-Gvir taunting dozens of activists detained at an Israeli port.

item.title: Ebola vaccine could take nine months as death toll rise further, WHO warns
item.description: In its latest update, the World Health Organization says there have now been 139 suspected deaths and 600 cases.

item.title: What we know about the San Diego mosque attack suspects
item.description: Authorities say the teenage suspects shared a "broad hatred" of multiple religions and racial groups.

item.title: What is Ebola and why is stopping the latest outbreak so difficult?
item.description: An outbreak of Ebola in DR Congo involves a rare strain and is in an area affected by conflict.
